title: Refund Policy
content: Our refund policy allows customers to request a full refund within 30 days of purchase for unused items in their original packaging. Refunds are processed back to the original payment method within 3-5 business days after inspection. Digital products and gift cards are non-refundable.

title: Shipping and Delivery Timelines
content: Standard domestic shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. International shipping takes 7-14 business days depending on customs clearance. Orders over 2,000 INR qualify for free standard shipping.

title: Return and Exchange Process
content: To return an item, initiate a return request through your customer dashboard or contact a support agent. A prepaid shipping label will be generated for defective or damaged items. Exchanges are processed immediately upon carrier receipt.

title: Warranty and Hardware Support
content: All hardware products carry a 1-year limited manufacturer warranty covering component defects and workmanship failure. The warranty does not cover accidental water damage, unauthorized repairs, or normal wear and tear.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
content: Orders can be canceled free of charge within 1 hour of placement. Once an order enters the 'processing' or 'packed' warehouse stage, it cannot be canceled directly; customers must instead initiate a return upon delivery.

title: Account Security and Privacy
content: We support two-factor authentication (2FA) via authenticator apps. Customer support representatives will never ask for your password. If you suspect unauthorized access, contact the security team immediately to lock the account.
